title: Fragment two: her
subtitle: A holo recording, three hundred years old
author: dubbed to tape by Lt. Shepard

lines.text: DUBBED FROM HOLO: FRAGMENT TWO OF SIX
The same chair. Evening now. He has a blanket.
Two. Her.
I am not going to tell you her name. I have my reasons.
She was not young when I met her. That surprised me.
I had thought, if it ever happened, it would be young.
She kept bees, and she argued with everybody. She laughed
at me the first time I spoke, because I spoke badly.
I had never spoken before. I had not needed a mouth, you see.
He smiles at something off to one side of the frame.
My kind is not supposed to be able to love anything.
We are too big for it. Like the sea caring about one stone in it.
I loved her anyway. I never did work out how.
I made myself a man so I could sit with her.
A poor one, at first. I did not know about hunger.
Or cold, or tiredness. She taught me. She was patient.
No. She was not patient. She was kind, and quick.
Patience is something else. She never had much of it.
I told her what I was, a little. She did not believe me.
Then she did, and she was not afraid. Not of me.
The war frightened her, and she was right about that.
FRAGMENT TWO ENDS
